Continue to develop linguistic, sociolinguistic, pragmatic and intercultural competence in everyday situations.

Improve and develop the four language skills: listening, speaking, reading, writing.
Expand and develop active vocabulary on everyday and professional topics.
Expand and develop grammatical competence on everyday and professional topics.
